<thought>We need a SMILES that matches the observed exact mass ≈ 100.0524, which corresponds to the molecular formula C₅H₈O₂. A simple structure with this formula is a six‑membered lactone (δ‑valerolactone). Its SMILES is O=C1CCCCO1, which is a valid SMILES and yields the correct formula.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C1CCCCO1</final_answer>
